name: erc7702-delegation-sample
description: ERC-7702 delegation sample with Foundry + viem

scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:anvil && pnpm run deploy:entrypoint
scripts.deploy:entrypoint: cd ./lib/account-abstraction && yarn install && yarn deploy --network localhost
scripts.getdeposit: cast call 0x433709009B8330FDa32311DF1C2AFA402eD8D009 "balanceOf(address)" 0xe7f1725e7734ce288f8367e1bb143e90bb3f0512 | cast to-dec | cast from-wei
scripts.test: echo "Run: anvil (terminal 1), forge script deploy:anvil (terminal 2), pnpm delegate (terminal 3)"
